title.en: busan fireworks festival on gwangalli beach.
title.tr: gwangalli plajı'nda busan havai fişek festivali.

line.en: the 21st busan fireworks festival, main show at 19:00 over gwangalli. buses stop near the beach around 18:00, so go early. watching from the sand is free; paid seats on nol.
line.de: das 21. busan-feuerwerksfestival, die hauptshow um 19:00 über gwangalli. busse halten am strand etwa ab 18:00 nicht mehr, also früh kommen. vom sand aus kostenlos; sitzplätze über nol.
line.tr: 21. busan havai fişek festivali, ana gösteri 19:00'da gwangalli üzerinde. plajın yanındaki otobüsler 18:00 civarı durur, erken git. kumdan izlemek ücretsiz; koltuklar nol'den.

sparks.why: 21st Busan Fireworks Festival, Sat 7 Nov 2026, main show about 19:00 at Gwangalli Beach, per Travie and KKday 2026 festival guides; the sources agree on the date and the bus cut-off.
